metadata.Description:
CI/CD Processes
Security Checks
for more details - refer to Control statement
CI/CD Processes
1. Implement a unified CI/CD pipeline, which integrates with SCB Clouds.
2. Automate code quality checks, unit tests, and integration tests across all environments.
3. Use infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools like Terraform to define and version control cloud resources consistently.
Security Checks
1. Integrate automated security scanning tools like Snyk and SonarQube into the CI/CD pipeline.
2. Implement automated vulnerability assessments for container images and cloud configurations.
metadata.controlTitle: Ensure secure and standardized deployment policies are in place, including CI/CD processes, security checks, containerization, configuration management, rollback procedures, monitoring, training, and regular reviews.
